Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly assumed that the formal title "Surintendant des Bâtiments du Roi" (supervisor of the royal works) applied to Jean Baptiste Androuet du Cerceau's role under Henry III of Poland (1573–1575), whereas historical evidence indicates he held the title "architecte de la cour" (court architect) during that specific reign. This misinterpretation of the upstream data led the Planner to direct the WebSurfer toward a search query that failed to retrieve the correct specific title for the Polish period, creating a path that was difficult to recover from without subsequent corrective pivots.
